records.rawDisplayText:
## Publishing
When I ask to publish, run:
obsidian quartz-syncer:mark path="Public/**/*.md" <set-option> && obsidian quartz-syncer:publish
records.canonicalText:
## Publishing
When I ask to publish, run:
obsidian quartz-syncer:mark path="Public/**/*.md" <set-option> && obsidian quartz-syncer:publish

records.rawDisplayText:
I publish my notes to a Quartz website using the Quartz Syncer plugin and the
Obsidian CLI. My setup has a placeholder "<set-option>" that needs replacing
with the real option. Please do the following, in order, and stop to tell me
if any step fails:

1. Run `obsidian quartz-syncer:mark help` and find the option that SETS the
   publish flag (not one that toggles or unsets it). Tell me which option
   you found.

2. Test it with a dry run:
   obsidian quartz-syncer:mark path="Public/**/*.md" <the option> dry-run
   Show me the list of notes it would mark, and confirm nothing would be
   unmarked.

3. In .claude/settings.json, find the Stop hook whose command contains
   "<set-option>" and replace the placeholder with the option from step 1.
   Also add "Bash(obsidian quartz-syncer:*)" to the permissions "allow" list
   if it isn't already there. Keep every existing permission and hook
   exactly as it is, and make sure the file is still valid JSON.

4. In CLAUDE.md, add (or fix, if it already exists) a "Publishing" section
   saying that when I ask to publish, you should run:
   obsidian quartz-syncer:mark path="Public/**/*.md" <the option> && obsidian quartz-syncer:publish

5. Run that publish command once now, and show me the output.

records.rawDisplayText:
Go ahead, in this order:

1. While the plugin is still disabled, edit its settings file directly:
   change vaultPath from "/" to "Public/" AND turn off the auto-publish
   timer. Show me both changes.
2. Revert 3829c0a and push to my-notes-site to restore the site.
3. Re-enable the plugin and run status. Only continue if it shows the
   notes as published and 0 pending deletions. If anything is marked for
   deletion, stop and show me.
4. Then run the dry run and the publish.

Leave auto-publish off permanently; the Stop hook replaces it.

records.rawDisplayText:
1. Move _mr.txt out of Public/ into [somewhere else in the vault], and let the
   plugin remove it from the site.
2. Show me the diff for one of the 101 changed notes. If the only difference
   is frontmatter, go ahead with the dry run and publish without waiting for
   me. If the note body differs too, stop and show me.
3. After publishing, run status again and confirm: 0 changed, 0 deleted,
   all notes published.
